title: EmDash Apply: with no valid email typed, every form of the map mails the account that pressed Apply, in every language
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-emdash.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "no email typed: the forms mail the person who pressed Apply, an address no page shows; a typed email still wins"; "an email the tool would not take".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 29).

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): with no email, or one the tool's rule rejects ('n/a', a phone), every <slug>-<locale> form of the map in every seed language (hidden ones included) gets settings.notifyEmails = [account email] through the forms door with the settings alone (never pages), a form the map does not name is left, the account address reaches no page and no --answers-json; a typed valid email still wins.
evidence: Ledger L05 (EmDash part), 05/10/2026: an EmDash site made with Apply where the customer gave no email mailed every enquiry and newsletter signup to the demo company's sales desk; after the first fix a junk email answer, and hidden languages' forms, still did. Reds 1806d9d55, a36ab61c4, 42e28727b; fixes 134766517, 47f0776ca, f021b0477.
fence: The account address is a recipient only: never one of the tool's answers, never on a page; forms outside the map are untouched.

tests: no email typed: the forms mail the person who pressed Apply, an address no page shows; a typed email still wins
an email the tool would not take
